candidate_diagnostics.qualification: Candidate-supplied, not independently verified. First 512 ordered impressions: 508 nonempty, 4 empty, 60,475 visible events; only 16 brand-only-match impressions and 51 target-brand-zero impressions. Not representative population estimates. No backward/Jacobian values are supplied. Attention mass, cosine and logit changes do not establish relevance. Scorer category-match slices may use a different history scope; missing-brand/unseen-field performance slices are absent.

observations.observation: All 23 supplied model trajectories succeeded operationally. Full count correction loses AUC for pooling (-0.0017334134) and DIN (-0.0001905060). Half correction improves pooling (+0.0005804055) but loses DIN AUC (-0.0002082243). Half pooling remains below DIN. These are negative or limited scientific outcomes, not failed execution.

Round-3 joint product restriction improved AUC over its ordinary adapter by 0.0011629547; removing cross-field products alone nearly matched it. The joint version had slightly worse Logloss than the cross-field-removal-only arm. Round-4 replays preserved the reported outcomes, while baseline versus ordinary adapter retained a small numerical-path discrepancy. This supports local behavior, not universal benefit from both removals.

The round-6 same-body aligned/raw bridge exactly reproduces historical raw aligned AUC, Logloss and every supplied slice metric/count at seed 42. Its source hash differs. This narrows the earlier mixed-round raw-corner uncertainty at the outcome level; source and backward identity remain unverified.

Full-gradient normalized aligned remains the validation incumbent: AUC 0.6149816911798147, Logloss 0.19656340759133067. Detached aligned reaches AUC 0.6145833321081287, Logloss 0.19663658831646288. Full-minus-detached is +0.00039835907168606077 AUC and -0.0000731807251322103 Logloss. Detached aligned still beats aligned raw by +0.00008929768088694612 AUC and -0.00005383749266427151 Logloss.

Crossed full-minus-detached AUC is +0.00004607634386211146 but Logloss is worse by 0.00012588645933467313. The pairing-by-gradient interaction is +0.0003522827278239493 AUC and -0.00019906718446688343 Logloss. Alignment still wins under either gradient rule and under raw products.

Both detached checkpoints report identical same-state full/detached products and logits (max absolute differences zero). Candidate diagnostics show zero padding mass, zero empty summary, weight-sum errors <=1.1920928955078125e-7 and unit-product norm errors <=1.7881393432617188e-7. No floor cases occur in 60,475 visible events among the first 512 impressions. Backward correctness and population absence of floor cases are not measured.

Full aligned is not uniformly best. In the highest training-frequency slice (1,004,912 impressions, 33,140 positives), its AUC 0.6365456862 is below detached 0.6365801374 and raw 0.6367937224. In history_17_64 (157,391 impressions, 6,311 positives), full aligned loses both metrics to raw. Empty-history changes have only 310 positives and zero direct history summaries; shared training effects are plausible.

All detailed interaction models have 17,130,275 parameters (17,078,688 embedding; 51,587 dense). Full-unit peak GPU bytes are 832,739,328 versus 800,846,848 detached. Their training times span about 521-529 seconds. Single-run timing and memory are observations; no equal-compute frontier or production throughput gain is established.

interpretations.claim: The denominator derivative is a consequential training intervention in the aligned seed-42 implementation, conditional on receipt-described isolation. Identical same-state forwards and different trained validation outcomes weaken a forward-value-only explanation for the full-versus-detached difference.
interpretations.qualification: Single seed, candidate-supplied forward checks, no independently measured backward derivatives. No semantic relevance or universal optimization benefit established.

interpretations.claim: Detached normalization retains a small aligned benefit over raw; the unsuccessful attempt to improve the incumbent does not refute normalization. It remains an informative control.
interpretations.qualification: Do not interpret full/raw and detached/raw differences as a causal mediation decomposition or percentage of mechanism explained. Models were separately optimized and checkpoint-selected; detached still has numerator gradients.

interpretations.claim: Alignment wins with raw, full-unit and detached-unit products. Equal explicit product norm and parameter count constrain a scalar-magnitude-only explanation, while coordinate distributions, Jacobians, effective function classes and adaptation through other blocks remain alternatives.
interpretations.qualification: One-seed controlled local performance support; not proof that category/brand semantics cause the gains.

interpretations.claim: The new raw bridge addresses the earlier implementation concern at the observed-score level, while same-seed replay equality does not resolve seed robustness. Earlier count-correction failures remain separate negative evidence.

prior_work_and_difference.inherited_components: Per receipts: static/history embeddings; category/brand/action/recency features; target-aware scorer, masked softmax aggregation, history values and classifier; optimizer/loss, initialization policy and training/data recipe. Source-level claims remain conditional.
prior_work_and_difference.local_algebra: Let D=q_c*h_c+q_b*h_b, X=q_c*h_b+q_b*h_c, C=(q_c+q_b)*u, with * elementwise and u action/recency context. Ordinary product block is D+X+C. Round-3 cross_only REMOVES X and retains D+C; it is not the round-5/6 crossed replacement X alone. Unit normalization is z=p/max(||p||_2,epsilon), with p=D or X; exact floor constant is unexposed. Latest detached intervention stops only the denominator derivative. Other blocks/history values retain context and mixed-field information. No new parameters are added.
prior_work_and_difference.gradient_hypothesis: For nonfloored p, r=||p|| and z=p/r, full Jacobian is (I-zz^T)/r, detached-denominator Jacobian I/r. Forwards agree at a fixed state while radial gradient components differ through this channel. This is conditional algebra, not measured backward evidence or removal of all normalization gradients. Floored cases require separate checks.
prior_work_and_difference.tested_difference: Round 6 supplies a forward-matched training derivative intervention for each pairing and a same-body raw bridge. Product normalization/replacement is distinct from log-count attention correction and softmax removal.
